prompt: The video begins with the viewer emerging from a dark cave into an expansive outdoor scene, revealing a rocky shoreline under a cloudy sky. The camera smoothly transitions from the shadowed interior to the natural light outside, capturing the rugged terrain and scattered boulders. As the perspective moves forward, the camera pans slightly to the right, showcasing dense vegetation clinging to the rocky slopes. The movement continues along the uneven path, with the camera tilting occasionally to emphasize the steep inclines and declines. The overcast weather casts a muted palette of grays and browns across the landscape, enhancing the sense of solitude. The viewer's journey progresses towards a dilapidated stone structure partially covered by ivy, hinting at past human activity. The camera then shifts focus back to the coastline, where waves gently crash against the rocks. The scene concludes with a sweeping view of the vast sea stretching to the horizon, framed by the dramatic cliffs and lush greenery, all captured from a steady, first-person perspective that immerses the viewer in the serene yet wild environment of Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China.
